blocks.text: MANILA – The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) has reminded private sector companies of their obligation to give their employees their 13th month pay. In an interview on Thursday, DOLE Secretary Francis Tolentino said employers must pay the extra one-month salary of their workers as provided by law. He also expressed gratitude to firms that have already released their workers’ 13th month and have complied. “Thank you to those who have already complied. The law mandates that the 13th-month pay be paid in full no later than December 24,” the DOLE chief said. “It is the worker’s right to receive […]...
